_comment: Machine-readable enums. Classifiers and the NLP stack read THIS file. Every allowed value in the framework, with its glyph. If a value is not here, it is not legal.
_changelog: v2.1: Collapsed 7 media-specific types back into reach.format. Added question + series + audienceProfile. GPT correction: atomize the descent process, not the delivery formats.

audienceProfile._comment: Reusable audience configurations. Referenced by ID, not rewritten per atom.

propagationScope._comment: FAILURE travelling outward. Every entry here is a failure type. Status ceilings are a different direction and live in statusCeiling below.

statusRank._comment: Ordering of the confidence ladder. weakened sits at 1 because it was knocked down from higher. Dead states are not ranked - they are absolute ceilings.

statusCeiling._comment: STATUS travelling up from dependencies. The third direction, added 2026-07-26. propagationScope covers failure going out; descentInvariant.confidencePreserved covers confidence going down to a public audience; this covers status going up. Enforced by _scripts/validate_atoms.py::check_status_monotonicity.
statusCeiling.rule: status <= min(status of every dependsOn target, and of every bridgesTo target whose grade propagates)
statusCeiling.deadRule: any dependsOn target in a dead state is an absolute ceiling - the dependent cannot hold any live status
statusCeiling.exceptionRule: status may exceed the ceiling ONLY when the atom carries rederivation.artifact naming an independent re-derivation. Citation, restatement, summary and compression are NOT re-derivation.
statusCeiling.basis: data processing inequality - truth -> source -> restatement is a Markov chain and post-processing cannot increase information about the source. Re-derivation breaks the chain, which is why it is the only exception.
